map.把犬猫真实年龄折算成对等人类岁数，直观理解它的生命阶段与养护重点。: Convert a dog's or cat's real age into equivalent human years to intuitively understand its life stage and care priorities.
map.按换算后的阶段（幼年/成年/老年）匹配饮食、疫苗、运动与体检频率。: Match diet, vaccines, exercise and checkup frequency to the converted stage (juvenile/adult/senior).
map.向领养人科普“小型犬更长寿、老年来得晚”等品种差异。: Brief adopters on breed differences such as "small dogs live longer and reach old age later".
map.：猫 3 岁 → 16+(3-2)×4 = 20 人类岁（成年）；小型犬 5 岁: A 3-year-old cat -> 16 + (3-2)x4 = 20 human years (adult); a 5-year-old small dog -> 16*ln5 + 31 = about 56.75, so 57 human years (adult); a 3-year-old large dog -> 22*ln3 + 15 + 2 = about 41 human years (already senior). The tool also labels stages as under 1 juvenile / under 7 adult / 7 and older senior.
map.猫和狗的换算公式一样吗？: Are the conversion formulas for cats and dogs the same?
map.不一样。猫：<1岁×15、<2岁 24+(a-1)×2、≥2岁 16+(a-2): They differ. Cat: under 1 year x 15, under 2 years 24 + (a-1)x2, 2 years and older 16 + (a-2)x4. Dog: 2 years or younger, small/medium take 12, large take age x 10.5; over 2 years, small/medium use 16*ln(age) + 31 and large adds 2 more (capped at 100 years). Large dogs age faster.
map.换算结果能当医疗依据吗？: Can the conversion result serve as medical evidence?
map.仅作参考。公式给出近似对等人类年龄，帮助理解阶段；具体寿命与健康管理仍受遗传、营: For reference only. The formula gives an approximate equivalent human age to help you understand life stage; actual lifespan and health management still depend on genetics, nutrition and medical care, and senior cats and dogs should have more frequent checkups.
